quarterly_data.signal: Preliminary Q3 FY2026 results (fair-disclosure filing of consolidated preliminary operating results, DART rcept_no 20261008800055, filed 10-08-2026; K-IFRS consolidated; amounts in KRW hundred millions as the table states them). Q3 2026 revenue 96,434 against 75,602 in Q2 2026 (+27.6% QoQ) and 60,654 in Q3 2025 (+59.0% YoY); January-September cumulative revenue 237,586 against 188,442 (+26.1%). Q3 operating profit 7,560 against 1,133 in Q2 (+567.3% QoQ) and 6,013 a year earlier (+25.7% YoY); cumulative operating profit 6,616 against 14,681 (-54.9%). The filing notes that the Q3 revenue of 96,434 and operating profit of 7,560 include the expected Q3 2026 North American production subsidy effect under the US IRA Advanced Manufacturing Production Credit (45X) and similar programs; excluding it, Q3 2026 revenue is 92,265, operating profit 3,391 and the operating margin +3.7%. Since Q1 2026 the company has changed how it presents the North American production subsidy: revenue including the subsidy is shown as 'revenue and other income' in the disclosed statements, and the prior-year figures were restated on the same basis. Pre-tax and net profit were not given; the figures are preliminary, before the external auditor's review, and may differ from actual results.
